name: orbit-claude-extension
description: Orbit - Lifecycle Marketing System for Claude, packaged as a local Claude-first MCP extension.

scripts.check: node -e "const r=f=>JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8')).version;const v={'package.json':r('package.json'),'manifest.json':r('manifest.json'),'server.json':r('server.json')};const u=[...new Set(Object.values(v))];if(u.length>1){process.stderr.write('Version mismatch: '+JSON.stringify(v)+'\n');process.exit(1)}console.log('Version check OK: '+u[0])" && for f in server/*.js scripts/*.js scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo "Syntax check OK"

//overrides: Force patched TRANSITIVE deps pulled in by the mjml / hono trees. These carry high-severity advisories and gate the release workflow's `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high`. Every pin stays INSIDE the existing major version, so mjml 5.1.0 is untouched — do NOT let `npm audit fix --force` bump mjml itself, which moved mjml2html to async at 5.1.0 and broke the compiler once already. A caret range here is not a pin; the lockfile is — commit package-lock.json with every change. Re-check with `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` and `npm run smoke`.
